channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: As addictive as heroin and cocaine?
item.description: The widely repeated claim that nicotine is as addictive as heroin and cocaine does not accurately reflect the conclusions of the 1988 US Surgeon General's report. (Published on November 23, 2026bymedium.com)

item.title: Vietnam Closes Door on Nicotine Pouches
item.description: Vietnam has approved new legislation extending its tobacco restrictions to nicotine pouches and shisha, alongside existing bans on e-cigarettes and heated tobacco products. (Published on November 23, 2026bynicotineinsider.com)

item.title: When the Endgame Forgets the People Still Smoking
item.description: The UK's generational tobacco ban has renewed debate about the needs of adults who continue to smoke. While preventing future smoking is an important objective, restrictions on vaping flavours, accessibility and affordability could unintentionally undermine smoking cessation efforts. (Published on November 23, 2026bysubstack.com)
